title.narrative: Supporting Green Industrial Development in Ghana: Biogas Technology and Business for Sustainable Growth

description.narrative: This project seeks to promote the transfer of biogas technology between Korea and Ghana through the following interlinked interventions: a) piloting of an industrial-scale biogas plant, and business and enterprise development support for biogas companies; b) conducting targeted research on industrial-scale biogas technologies; and c) awareness raising and policy recommendations. These interventions, seen together, will address existing barriers to market-based dissemination of industrial-scale biogas technologies in Ghana. The project approach is predicated on the findings of a detailed analysis of the state of biogas industry and lessons from various past and ongoing initiatives/projects in Ghana. The Government of Ghana is fully committed to renewable energy technologies as shown by the passing of the Renewable Energy Bill in December 2011. This project will build on this solid commitment and leadership by the Government of Ghana and will result in change in business culture towards green industry. Given the relevance of the biogas technology to the greater ECOWAS sub-region, it is foreseen that Ghana will serve as centre of excellence and partner with ECREEE to disseminated biogas technologies in the sub-region.
